place.label: 01 — The Place
place.heading: A restored fisherman's house in the mountains of Imsouane.
place.paragraph1: Maryama is more than a house. It is a piece of our family's heart — built from love, resilience and the quiet belief that even after loss, something beautiful can grow again. In 2024, after our family restaurant was demolished, my father and I started over with a handful of bricks, the hands of his lifelong friend Ibrahim, and a vision only I could see at the time.
place.paragraph2: The house carries my mother’s name, our way of keeping her presence in everything we have built. Three rooms, a seasonal garden of mint and herbs you are welcome to pick from, and the ocean below. Our wish is simple: that you leave the noise behind, wake to the view, breathe deeper, and remember what it feels like to simply be.
place.paragraph3: Endings are not always endings. Sometimes they are quiet beginnings. Welcome home.

faq.label: 03 — Good to know
faq.heading: Questions, answered.
faq.note: Anything else, write to us on WhatsApp — we answer the same day.

checkIn.question: Check-in and keys
checkIn.answer: Check-in is from 3:00 PM. Our manager meets you at the house, hands over the keys and shows you around. Tell us your arrival time and we will be waiting.

checkout.question: Checkout
checkout.answer: By 11:00 AM. Leave used towels in the bathroom basket, run the dishwasher, take the trash to the bins by the gate and return the keys to Khalid or the agreed spot.

houseRules.question: House rules
houseRules.answer: No smoking inside or on the balcony. Quiet hours from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. Only registered guests stay overnight. Please lock doors and windows when you go out.

kitchen.question: Kitchen, garden, laundry
kitchen.answer: The kitchen is fully equipped and yours to use, with fresh linens, towels, a washer and a dryer. Pick what you need from the seasonal garden — mint, herbs, vegetables. The village market is a short walk away.

activities.question: Surf and other things to do
activities.answer: We surf the longest wave in Africa with our guests, beginner to intermediate. Also surf skate sessions, the Timlaline dunes at sunset, a 40-minute hike down to a hidden beach, a day in Essaouira, and pizza nights at the house. Ask us for dates and prices.
